name: naming series in emp
Notify HR when Employee UPDATES a field
Notify Manager - Employee Onboarding Assigned
script:
if doc.workflow_state == "Pending Manager Input": sender_email = frappe.db.get_value("HR Settings", "HR Settings", "sender_email") or None recipients = [] if doc.hiring_manager: email = frappe.db.get_value("User", doc.hiring_manager, "email") if email: recipients.append(email) if recipients: form_url = frappe.utils.get_url_to_form(doc.doctype, doc.name) frappe.sendmail( recipients=recipients, subject="Action Required: Fill Onboarding Activities - " + (doc.employee_name or doc.name), sender=sender_email, message=( "

Dear Manager,

" "

Please fill the onboarding activities for new joiner " + (doc.employee_name or "") + ".

" "" "" "" "" "" "
Employee" + (doc.employee_name or "") + "
Department" + (doc.department or "") + "
Designation" + (doc.designation or "") + "
Date of Joining" + str(doc.date_of_joining or "") + "
" "

Please add onboarding activities like Laptop, SIM, Email ID, Seating etc.

" "

Fill Activities

" "

Regards,
HR Team

" ), reference_doctype=doc.doctype, reference_name=doc.name, )
